import math,json
rows=[{'n':n,'c':c,'k':n,'estimate':1-math.comb(n-c,n)/math.comb(n,n),'any_success':int(c>0)} for n in (1,2,4,8) for c in range(n+1)]
print(json.dumps({'all_equal':all(x['estimate']==x['any_success'] for x in rows),'rows':rows,'candidates_per_mode':24*(1+2+4+8),'scope':'n=k combinatorial identity, no HumanEval execution'},indent=2))
